integrity: The complete proof, finite-field exhaustive checker and recorded output are embedded together with this metadata; no external dependencies beyond Python 3 are needed to run the checker. The checker supports rather than proves the general formula.
scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns idempotent ordinary derivations of finite-dimensional Heisenberg Lie algebras; geometry is explicitly reduced geometry, without assertion about the unreduced scheme. The group-grading normal form is prior literature, not new. Historical priority and independent mathematical validation remain unresolved.
title: Rank spectra and component geometry of idempotent derivations of Heisenberg Lie algebras
